text:
Alix: Heads-up — we need to pin the billing API to v2 for the next 48h to avoid a surprise with the downstream analytics job. I can coordinate the window but need clear owners for the toggle + SDK changes.

Marco: I can own the runtime toggle and routing rule. Planning to add a feature flag in traffic-router:rb. ETA tomorrow AM.

Tess: I’ll take the SDK bump — have one PR that updates the header handling and adds a compatibility shim. Will open it today and mark for review. PR: #4128.

Sam: FYI the analytics team reported duplicate events when they hit mixed v1/v2 traffic last night — might be related to header negotiation.

Alix: Thanks. Tess — can you add a quick migration note in the README and a changelog entry? Also add an explicit acceptance test that sends both v1/v2 headers.

Tess: Yep. Adding tests now. Example request I'll use:

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/billing/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "X-Redwood-API-Version: v2" \
  -d '{"customer_id":"1234","items":[...] }'
```

Marco: devops-bot, can you schedule the short flag flip for 2024-06-10 09:00 UTC? I want a 30-min window with observability on.

devops-bot: scheduled flag flip "billing-api-pin" for 2024-06-10T09:00:00Z. Post-mortem window 60m. Will post rollout message in #incidents.

Sam: One ask — if the SDK PR touches the client header parsing, please avoid breaking the optional Content-Type variants. We still receive application/json; charset=UTF-8 from some legacy clients.

Tess: Noted. I ran a quick grep across client libs; will normalize header parsing and add a fuzz test.

Alix: Quick ownership checklist: Marco = routing & flag; Tess = SDK + tests + changelog; Sam = analytics smoke; I (Alix) will drive comms. If anyone else needs to be looped in, shout now.

sdk-ci: CI failure on PR #4128: integration-suite.billing.compat failed on Node 18 matrix. Error: "unexpected header format in /billing/generate".

Tess: On it — reproducing locally. Might be the shim order in client parsing. Pushing a fix branch now (tess/sdk-header-shim-fix).

Marco: Once Tess has the fix, I’ll run a canary slice (5%) for 15m and validate event dedupe in analytics. If green, we proceed with full 30-min pin.

Alix: Perfect. Action items: Tess — land fix + tests + changelog; Marco — schedule canary + monitor; Sam — validate analytics once canary starts. I’ll prepare the external comms template. :thumbsup:

Tess: Will ping here when PR is green and merged.

sdk-ci: PR #4128 merged by Tess at 2024-06-09T20:12:01Z. CI: all green on matrix except a flaky timeout in e2e-slow which is unrelated.

Alix: Great — Marco, please kick the canary at 09:00 UTC and post the status in this thread. If anything odd, revert the flag and we’ll rollback the SDK release.

Marco: Can confirm canary started 2024-06-10T09:00Z on slice billing-v2-5pct. Monitoring dashboards: https://dashboards.redwood.ai/billing/rollout/1751234567

Sam: Analytics smoke looks clean at 09:10 UTC — no duplicate events seen in the 5% slice.

Marco: Canary complete at 09:15 UTC. No regressions. Rolling to 100% now.

Alix: Closing loop — full pin complete 2024-06-10T09:45Z. Thanks all. I’ll update the migration doc and close the coordination ticket.

Sam: Nice work everyone.

(thumbsup reaction from Tess)
